changes: Updated the drivability decision doc and CLI guidance so INIT routes through init_preflight; added story-level scope-plan dispatch with phase-aware refusal outside PLAN; added checklist_add milestone ledger sync advisory and forced read-only milestone status display for ledger-backed developer UX; added focused tests and CLI docs.
usage: Use lattice init_preflight --storyId=B-xxx before INIT_CHECK when an INIT story is blocked; use lattice milestone_status --storyId=B-xxx or covered developer commands to see the read-only milestone table; use lattice dispatch --storyId=B-xxx --agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan only during PLAN for reviewer-written scope evidence.
expectedOutcome: A developer or agent sees the next correct lifecycle command instead of guessing: INIT guidance names init_preflight, non-PLAN scope-plan dispatch refuses instead of suggesting a failing scope_check_save command, and milestone status is visible as read-only UX when ledger-backed developer commands run.
actualTranscript: TEST evidence captured in .lattice/story/actives/B-90d6/evidence/transcript-diff.md: lattice validate passed 43/43 commands; lattice milestone_status --storyId=B-90d6 rendered Milestone Status - B-90d6 in TEST with confirmed ledger; CLI help shows init_preflight before INIT_CHECK; focused init-dispatch and milestone-status tests passed.
outcomeDiff: No user-value gap found; actual CLI output matches the expected visible behavior. Milestone status is displayed as read-only observability and does not mutate the ledger or claim DONE/Authority/production readiness.
limitations: Scope warnings remain for acknowledged command-generated ProofStory metadata paths only; CHK-008 was added after DEV so it is covered by checklist/evidence/tests but not a pre-DEV milestone-ledger row.
